text:
aisha_cs: Heads-up — renewal signal on PoppyAI. Saw a sharp usage drop and their CTO left last week. Looks like they might be evaluating alternatives.
renewal-bot: [ALERT] Account: PoppyAI — Usage -72% MoM, Active users last 7 days: 6, Typical seats: 45. Risk: HIGH. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/accounts/poppyai/health (auto-report)
sam_csm: yikes. @jordan_ae did we hear anything from their champion since the CTO change?
jordan_ae: had a quick note from their PM on Fri — said they're pausing new integrations while org sorts leadership. No formal churn signal yet, but they did ask for a demo from Nimbus.
liam_support: pulled logs for the last 30 days. small snippet: ```SELECT COUNT(session_id) FROM sessions WHERE account='poppyai' AND ts > now()-interval '30 days'; -- 48 (prev period 172)```
marta_se: also saw a spike in error rate around Feb 6 for their dedicated trial instance — retry loop on our KV cache. Might have contributed to reduced calls. I filed ENG ticket #INF-8472.
aisha_cs: ok timeline: usage drop + infra hiccup + CTO exit + competitor outreach. All 4 is bad. Suggest we treat this as active renewal at-risk.
sam_csm: agree. Proposed actions: 1) exec-level check-in with whoever is now owning platform decisions 2) offer a short health + remediation workshop (no charge) 3) 30-day free credits to rebuild momentum 4) deploy quick reliability patch for their instance, notify them. @marta_se can you confirm ETA on INF-8472 fix?
marta_se: INF-8472 owner pinged, looks like a small KV fallback patch, ETA 48 hours if no regressions. I'll queue a canary deploy and send update.
jordan_ae: I'll reach out to the PM and request a 30-min sync with their interim tech lead. If they mention Nimbus, ask what capability they liked and whether it's cost or latency.
liam_support: I'll prepare a short doc with recent error stats + mitigation + a couple of config tweaks they can apply immediately. Link to draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/internal/poppyai-triage (WIP)
aisha_cs: assigning owners: @jordan_ae — customer outreach; @marta_se — infra fix + canary; @liam_support — triage doc; @sam_csm — lead the renewal play and offer credits.
sam_csm: noted. I'll also prep an exec slide (1 pg) showing business impact and quick wins.
renewal-bot: [REMINDER] Follow-up checkpoint scheduled in 3 days: 1754567750 -> Please update thread with customer response or status.
aisha_cs: thanks team. Let's reconvene after the outreach. If we get pushback on credits, we'll escalate to sales for a short-term PO. :thumbsup:
